title: Query-conditioned behavioral compatibility routing for selective graph execution
question: Can a router trained to predict candidate/query behavioral compatibility recover the relevant executable candidates more reliably than the G-CASM-010 exact-identity router, while preserving capability-constrained selective execution?
hypothesis: Training on candidate/support compatibility rather than exact target identity should improve recovery of the support-consistent candidate set and therefore improve verified selective execution on held-out executable programs, without requiring evaluator-only target labels or verifier-only rows at routing time.

arms.name: behavioral_graph
arms.intervention: query-conditioned candidate/support cross-encoder using complete public executable graph features and compatibility supervision

arms.name: legacy_graph
arms.intervention: G-CASM-010 matched dual-encoder exact-identity router with complete public executable graph features

arms.name: behavioral_summary
arms.intervention: same behavioral compatibility objective with the 200-bit executable wiring field removed

arms.name: constant
arms.intervention: constant-score candidate ranking with deterministic candidate-order tie break

endpoints.name: minimum_adaptive_execution_work_fraction_at_capability
endpoints.role: primary — minimum adaptive exact-execution work fraction at support_size=4 among budgets retaining >=0.80 exhaustive capability
endpoints.description: At each M, use only the registered support_size=4 condition and select the minimum adaptive execution-work fraction among budgets whose verified semantic success is at least 0.80 of exhaustive exact execution.

endpoints.name: verified_selective_success
endpoints.role: secondary — exact verifier success after executing the selected candidate budget

endpoints.name: target_routing_recall
endpoints.role: secondary — probability the target candidate is admitted within budget

endpoints.name: support_set_recall
endpoints.role: secondary — fraction of exact support-consistent candidates recovered within budget

endpoints.name: target_rank
endpoints.role: secondary — exact target rank under the learned scorer

endpoints.name: exhaustive_exact_graph_success
endpoints.role: secondary — capability ceiling and eligibility gate

endpoints.name: routing_execution_work
endpoints.role: secondary — actual graph execution work after routing

held_constant: G-CASM-010 candidate generator and pinned external CASM generator commit
train/evaluation exact structure and complete truth-table disjointness
4-input Boolean program family and M levels
4 support rows for training and primary evaluation
exact graph executor and verifier rows are identical across learned arms
candidate feature width 290 with graph arm retaining the public 200-bit wiring field
five seeds, 1200 routing steps, 32 evaluation tasks per seed/M, budgets 1/2/4/8
primary endpoint selection rule and seed-level bootstrap are fixed before measurement

router.objective: row-level compatibility BCE plus support-set compatibility BCE

data_protocol.verifier_rows: all non-support rows, so 12/8/4 rows respectively

leakage_rules: Router inputs contain only public candidate features and observed support input/output rows.
Training labels are derived from each training candidate's public truth table against the observed support rows; evaluator target identity is never passed as a feature or loss target.
Evaluation verifier-only rows are never passed to routing.
Evaluation target structure and complete truth table are disjoint from router training.
Candidate ordering is shuffled independently of target placement and cannot affect model features.
Support-size conditions reuse a representation-independent row permutation and do not use verifier outcomes.
instrument_controls: exact exhaustive graph execution over the full candidate pool
training/evaluation structure and truth-table split assertions

primary_endpoint.criterion: At each M, report the minimum adaptive execution-work fraction among budgets retaining at least 0.80 of exhaustive exact-graph semantic success.

statistical_contract.primary_estimate: seed-level mean of the minimum-budget primary endpoint after applying the registered capability rule
statistical_contract.uncertainty: seed bootstrap 95 percent confidence interval with the complete budget-selection rule repeated inside each resample

decision_rule.condition: All benchmark, leakage, protocol, implementation, instrument, statistical and provenance gates pass.
decision_rule.licenses: the completed run is scientifically interpretable under the registered scope.
decision_rule.does_not_license: general intelligence, hidden-wiring inference, asymptotic sublinear scaling, or hardware speedup.

decision_rule.condition: behavioral_graph achieves a lower primary execution-work fraction than legacy_graph at matched capability, with the registered support_size=4 endpoint eligible.
decision_rule.licenses: bounded evidence that compatibility-conditioned routing improves selective graph execution on the registered workload.
decision_rule.does_not_license: universal routing superiority or asymptotic scaling.

decision_rule.condition: behavioral_graph improves support-set recall but does not meet the capability-constrained work criterion.
decision_rule.licenses: evidence that the compatibility objective changes relevant-set recovery without establishing selective-execution capability.

decision_rule.condition: No primary budget reaches the capability floor.
decision_rule.licenses: the registered router does not meet the capability-constrained criterion at that M.

interpretation_order: target routing recall and target rank
actual fixed and adaptive execution work

amendments.old_definition: legacy_graph trial budgets emitted routing and execution fields but did not emit the support_set_recall diagnostic consumed by the common 012 summarizer
amendments.new_definition: legacy_graph trial budgets emit support_set_recall and support_set_hit computed from the observed support rows and the legacy router's exact candidate ordering
amendments.rationale: The confirmatory run completed repository and experiment gates but terminated during final summarization with KeyError('support_set_recall'). The missing field is an instrument/recording defect; adding it does not change the intervention, training, evaluation tasks, or primary decision rule.
amendments.discovered: G-CASM-012 full confirmatory run 37209451643, during summary serialization before scientific result completion.
amendments.affected: legacy diagnostic serialization only; no scientific parameter, arm, benchmark, or endpoint decision rule changed.
amendments.no_result_under_previous_version: The run produced a checkpoint artifact containing raw trials but no completed scientific summary; no confirmatory result was reported under the faulty writer.

amendments.old_definition: minimum eligible adaptive execution-work fraction was selected after pooling trials across seeds, despite the statistical contract defining the seed as the independent resampling unit
amendments.new_definition: each seed independently applies the exhaustive/capability eligibility rule and selects its minimum eligible budget; the primary estimate is the mean of those seed-level minima and the bootstrap repeats that seed-level selection inside each resample
amendments.rationale: The contract explicitly specifies seed-level aggregation and no task-level IID assumption. The pooled selection could produce an eligible primary value even when one or more seeds failed the capability floor.
amendments.discovered: Pre-rerun audit of G-CASM-012 after the summary-field instrumentation failure, before any valid result was accepted.
amendments.affected: primary endpoint aggregation and bootstrap implementation only; no training schedule, arm, benchmark, or decision threshold changed
amendments.no_result_under_previous_version: No completed scientific result existed because the same run terminated during final summarization with a KeyError before the final artifact was emitted.
